resources.string: Everything you need for your first sale
Set up your store, build your inventory, take your first order and share a catalog with your customers.
Complete the steps in any order, or come back whenever you’re ready.
Open business details, review your name and currency, then save. Logo and description are optional.
Save five products. You can take orders with fewer products.
Add products to an order and save it. We recommend saving it as pending to explore the Fulfillment plan.
Open the Fulfillment plan and wait for it to load. Having enough inventory also counts.
Publish your catalog, then use its link or QR code to share it. Publication completes this step; sharing does not confirm delivery.
All five steps completed. Your business is ready!
